episodes.title: Piloto
episodes.summary: At 17, Alma is going through a tough time. One day, she shocks her high school with a banner reporting a sexual predator within its walls.

episodes.title: Zona cero
episodes.summary: While her parents frantically search for her, Alma's night out morphs into a blur of disappointment. An unexpected person catches Alma off guard.

episodes.title: Yo sí te creo, hermana
episodes.summary: As Alma grapples with disturbing flashbacks, Greta meets a captivating new acquaintance. Nata delves into her darker side.

episodes.title: A**hole Baby
episodes.summary: Cryptic online messages torment Alma with memories she'd prefer to forget. A heartfelt conversation brings two friends closer.

episodes.title: 8M
episodes.summary: As Alma and her mother make plans to celebrate International Women's Day, Nata's bond with Alberto is shaken. Greta's actions put her family at risk.

episodes.title: Berta
episodes.summary: At the hospital, Alma encounters a familiar face, who reveals something terrible. Nata stands her ground as Greta comes clean to David.

episodes.title: Cómo cazar a un depredador sexual
episodes.summary: Alma and Berta devise a plan to expose the school's dark underside. Nata gains a fresh perspective, using it to her advantage.

episodes.title: A sangre o lágrimas
episodes.summary: Authorities begin an investigation into the abuse allegations made online. Amid skepticism and a profound loss, Alma takes justice into her own hands.
